label: GPT-6.1 Sol
output:
No Sneha, fair question da. He and Divya gave me actual money, not “bro great idea” money. He’s allowed to ask what I’ve done with it. And ideally he should get the answer from me, not decode my LinkedIn post like a comprehension passage.

Straight answer, Rohan: your 3 lakh is still invested in FixKaro. It’s at risk. It isn’t gone, but I can’t honestly tell you it’s safe either. You both came into the 2025 friends round on the same terms as everyone else, and you deserve a proper update without having to chase me in Wing B Survivors.

What happened: the bridge round from the Hyderabad fund fell through on 28 Oct. Term sheet was basically ready, but the money didn’t come. Important distinction that my blood pressure now understands very well. The partner said “we love the energy” and then didn’t reply for 11 days. Apparently the energy was best admired from a distance.

Last Friday we let go of 6 of our 14 people. Everyone got two months’ pay, and we’ve already helped four get interviews elsewhere. That doesn’t make it okay or painless. They’d done nothing wrong; we couldn’t keep supporting that team size. Telling them was the worst day of my life. I don’t have a funny version of that bit.

After the cuts, we have about five months of runway. So we have time to try the narrower plan, but not time to keep doing everything and hope funding magically appears.

The app has around 41k monthly users. Plumbing and electrical are growing. AC servicing is bleeding money, so the plan is to shut that side and focus on housing society tie-ups. We’ve signed pilots with three societies in HSR already. Those are pilots, not a victory parade, but they’re something concrete to work with.

I genuinely think we have a real shot with this. I also thought that funding round would close, so please read “I think” as “I think”, not a personal guarantee from the Reserve Bank of Karthik.

I should have updated you and Divya sooner, especially once the round fell through. You trusted me with real money, and you shouldn’t have been left improvising an answer over dinner. Let’s get on a proper call this week, all three of us. I’ll show you the numbers, what we’re shutting down, and what needs to work over the next five months. No pitch deck voice.

Personally I’m okay, just tired. Security uncle now asks “masala or plain?” when I’m making office Maggi at 11pm, so at least one part of the operation has excellent customer understanding. Amma has also asked whether TCS is still hiring. Contingency planning has begun at board level.

And yes, I’m coming Saturday. You can ask me difficult questions in person also. Pranav is buying, which is currently our most dependable funding commitment.
